subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff & trial plan for StellarPay
messages:
From: Jared Li <jared.li@stellarpay.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation kickoff after today's discovery

Connor / Marissa —

Thanks again for the discovery today — that was really helpful to surface how StellarPay could use a hosted inference partner for our transaction enrichment and customer support assistants. Priya and I chatted and we're interested in running a short evaluation (2–3 weeks) to validate latency/cost and basic quality on our prompt set.

High level asks:
- Quick evaluation kickoff to align success criteria and trial plan
- A technical deep dive/demo with an SE to confirm integration approach
- Sample prompt set upload and initial evals

Are you available to kick this off next week? Priya (cc'd) will join for product/ops, and I'll loop in a couple engineers once we lock timing.

Thanks,
Jared
Jared Li
Head of Platform
StellarPay

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Li <jared.li@stellarpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff after today's discovery

Thanks Jared — appreciate the clear summary and glad the discovery was useful.

Recap from our side:
- Goal: 2-week evaluation to validate latency (p95 <= 300ms), cost per 1k tokens target, and quality on your prompt set for customer support intents.
- Success criteria (draft): accuracy on intent classification >= 92% (per your eval set), generation quality rated >= 4/5 by your SMEs, and integration path validated by StellarPay SRE/engineering.

Next steps / proposed timing:
- Evaluation kickoff meeting (45m): agenda = introductions, trial plan, roles & access, prompt set & eval methodology, timeline.
- Technical deep dive / demo with our SE (60m) later in the week to confirm integration details.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2026-05-26 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2026-05-27 14:00–14:45
- Thu 2026-05-28 09:00–09:45

I've looped in Rishi (SE) to propose a short technical agenda and list of prerequisites. Attached is a first-draft trial plan and our evaluation checklist for you to review (stellarpay_trial_plan_v1.pdf, redwood_eval_checklist.xlsx).

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/stellarpay-eval-kickoff

Would one of those slots work for you and Priya? If not, send a couple alternatives and we'll accommodate.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com

From: Jared Li <jared.li@stellarpay.com>

Connor —

Thanks, the draft success criteria look good. Wed 2026-05-27 14:00 PT works best for Priya and me.

A couple quick clarifications before the kickoff:
- For the prompt set, is CSV upload OK, and are you able to run both intent classification and generation quality evals out of the box?
- For the deep dive, can the SE cover auth (API keys vs. VPC options) and required network access (we're in AWS)?

I'll attach a small sample of our prompts for context (stellarpay_prompt_samples.csv).

Thanks — Jared

Hi Jared / Priya —

Thanks for the sample and questions. Short answers: yes, CSV is fine for the prompt set; we can run both classification and generation evals. For the kickoff and technical deep dive, here's a proposed SE agenda and prerequisites.

Proposed SE agenda (45–60m):
1) High-level architecture & integration options (API vs Private deployment)
2) Auth and networking: API keys, VPC peering options, regional considerations
3) Data handling & security: KMS, logs, retention policies (what we store on our side vs yours)
4) Eval workflow: how we ingest prompt CSVs, run evaluations, and report metrics
5) Next steps & handoffs (engineers, CS, timelines)

Prerequisites from StellarPay:
- Sample prompt CSV (thanks for sending)
- A read-only S3 bucket or secure link where you can upload larger prompt sets (or we can accept CSV email attachments for up to ~5k rows)
- List of stakeholders (engineering contact for integration)

If Wed 2026-05-27 14:00 PT is confirmed, I'll prepare a short demo of the eval tooling and bring example outputs for discussion.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Jared Li <jared.li@stellarpay.com>

Connor / Rishi —

Confirming Wed 2026-05-27 14:00 PT for the kickoff. Priya and I will join; I'll invite our lead SRE (Samir) to the deep dive.

I've uploaded the larger prompt set to a secure S3 bucket and shared a temporary read-only link (sent separately to your team). Attached earlier sample should help for the kickoff.

A couple notes for the evaluation checklist: please make sure the eval includes per-intent breakdowns (we care about a few low-frequency but high-impact intents). Also, can you add a small section on cost projection methodology for the trial?

Thanks — Jared
